subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage architecture and internal promotion surface now, while legacy remains the default and the validated lineage results still have material day-level residuals?
rationale: The patch can mechanically preserve legacy behavior, but deciding whether the additional accounting architecture, cache modes, and future authority switch belong in the product cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Land conservatively in stack order
options.body: Review the four branches in order, require fresh-install and upgrade-cache proof, and merge only with legacy remaining the default and promotion separately authorized.

options.title: Hold for broader parity evidence
options.body: Pause the stack until more finalized ordinary and fork-heavy days demonstrate acceptable day-level accuracy and operational cost.

options.title: Keep only diagnostic pieces
options.body: Adopt bounded aggregate diagnostics and performance tooling while deferring the authority selector and promotion contract.

recommendation.title: Land conservatively in stack order
recommendation.body: Review the four branches in order, require fresh-install and upgrade-cache proof, and merge only with legacy remaining the default and promotion separately authorized.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent scanner-history and Phase 1 containment work make this the strongest available owner for the permanent accounting and upgrade boundary.
